description: This course provides an introduction to a spectrum of approaches to interpreting fairy tales and folklore. Students read and discuss writings stemming from oral traditions such as German Kinder- und Hausmärchen collected by the Brothers Grimm, and Nordic mythology and sagas, as well as written works by Danish author Hans Christian Andersen and French author Charles Perrault. Analytical tasks consider the literary aspects and historical contexts of the works and the effects of text and film adaptations of "classic" tales into the 21st century.
name: Germanic Fairy Tales
